auth_variables.name: databricks_account_id
auth_variables.description: Required Databricks account UUID; preflight verifies every Databricks session targets it.

auth_variables.name: aws_account_id
auth_variables.description: Optional expected AWS account; pins the AWS provider's allowed_account_ids and preflight identity checks.

auth_variables.name: aws_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback AWS CLI profile. Prefer ./infra setup, which records the profile outside Git.

auth_variables.name: databricks_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback Databricks account profile. Prefer ./infra setup.

auth_variables.name: databricks_workspace_profile
auth_variables.description: Legacy fallback Databricks workspace profile. Prefer ./infra setup after the workspace exists.

auth_variables.name: deployment_id
auth_variables.description: Set by ./infra on every plan; drives derived resource names. Do not set it in tfvars.

backend_private_link.description: Route classic compute-to-control-plane traffic through back-end PrivateLink.

backend_private_link_subnets.description: Exactly two IPv4 endpoint subnet CIDRs, required when back-end PrivateLink is enabled.

public_access_enabled.description: Keep public workspace UI/API access. Operators and ./infra need it unless they run inside the private network.

name_prefix.description: Resource name prefix; derived from the deployment ID when null.

existing_metastore_name.description: Reuse an existing regional metastore instead of creating one. Most shared accounts already have one per region.

create_initial_catalog.description: Create the storage credential, external location, and initial catalog.

metastore_mode.description: create a dedicated metastore, assign existing_metastore_name, or auto-reuse the account metastore in the workspace region (creating one only if none exists).

databricks_connectivity_enabled.description: Also create the Unity Catalog credentials, external location, connection, and foreign catalog. Requires workspace and unity_catalog.

engine_version.description: Optional PostgreSQL engine version. Required when Lakeflow Connect source setup is enabled so the matching parameter-group family is deterministic.

lakeflow_connect_enabled.description: Enable PostgreSQL logical-replication parameters and create a write-only Secrets Manager credential for Lakeflow Connect source setup.

ephemeral_credentials.description: Write the broker password only to Secrets Manager (write-only attribute) so it is never stored in Terraform state. For new deployments.

topic_name.description: Topic written by the synthetic producer.

ephemeral_credentials.description: Write the broker password only to Secrets Manager (write-only attribute) so it is never stored in Terraform state. For new deployments.

service_port.description: Port of the simulated on-premises HTTP test service.

existing_network_connectivity_config_id.description: Reuse an existing NCC for serverless private endpoint rules instead of creating one.

auth_variables.name: subscription_id
auth_variables.description: Required Azure subscription; preflight verifies the Azure CLI session for it without changing the active subscription.

auth_variables.name: tenant_id
auth_variables.description: Optional Entra tenant. ./infra supplies the tenant of the selected subscription so every provider uses it.

auth_variables.name: databricks_account_id
auth_variables.description: Azure Databricks account UUID, required for account-level Unity Catalog resources.

auth_variables.name: databricks_auth_type
auth_variables.description: Databricks auth type for providers without a profile. ./infra sets azure-cli for local sessions; automation leaves it null.

auth_variables.name: databricks_account_profile
auth_variables.description: Optional Databricks account OAuth profile. Without it, the Azure CLI identity is used.

auth_variables.name: databricks_workspace_profile
auth_variables.description: Optional Databricks workspace profile. Without it, the Azure CLI identity is used.

auth_variables.name: deployment_id
auth_variables.description: Set by ./infra on every plan; drives derived resource names. Do not set it in tfvars.

front_end_private_link.description: Deprecated alias for browser_authentication; used only when browser_authentication is unset. Removed in the next release.

browser_authentication.description: Create the browser_authentication (browser SSO) private endpoint. The databricks_ui_api endpoint always exists.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Keep public workspace access. Disabling it requires front-end Private Link and running operators inside the private network.

name_prefix.description: Resource name prefix; derived from the deployment ID when null.

workspace_name.description: Workspace name; derived from the prefix when null.

allowed_ssh_source_cidr.description: Required CIDR allowed to reach the test VM over SSH.

admin_ssh_public_key.description: OpenSSH public key; when set, password authentication is disabled.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Expose the storage account's public endpoint (protected by RBAC).

allow_unreachable_storage.description: Acknowledge a metadata-only deployment when storage has no public or private compute path.

metastore_mode.description: create a dedicated metastore, reuse metastore_id (existing), or auto: keep the managed one, reuse the only regional metastore, or create one; fails when several regional metastores exist.

metastore_id.description: Existing metastore ID, required when metastore_mode is existing.

volume_storage_path.description: Storage prefix backing the external volume; ./infra seed uploads here.

allow_force_destroy.description: Allow Unity Catalog force deletion for disposable environments.

workspace_peering_enabled.description: Peer the SQL VNet with the workspace VNet and link its private DNS zone for classic compute and the test VM.

entra_admin_enabled.description: Make the deploying principal the SQL server Microsoft Entra administrator; SQL authentication stays enabled.

key_vault_enabled.description: Store generated SQL passwords in an RBAC Azure Key Vault.

databricks_secret_scope_enabled.description: Expose the Key Vault to the workspace as a Key Vault-backed secret scope (requires the workspace).

existing_network_connectivity_config_id.description: Reuse an existing Databricks NCC for serverless private endpoint rules.
